report.summary: All three current official-download packages installed successfully. WeChat pre-login UI and Xiaohongshu guest image feeds passed on the main/background displays. Douyin UI and switching worked, but some main/background video rendering was abnormal; playback compatibility did not pass.

report.parallelism: After dismissing the native mirrored window, display0 can return to Taku OS Home while display2 retains an app. Each app was cold-started separately on main/background displays; this does not establish two instances of the same app or account isolation.
limitations: No real-account login; messaging, payments, publishing, livestreaming, long-running notifications, and account risk controls not accepted.
This Xiaohongshu acceptance covers the recommended image feed and does not generalize to background video playback.

Douyin initially displayed main-screen content normally; later cold starts also showed abnormalities, and two different secondary-display videos showed green/colored stripes. Native system screencap had the same defect, ruling out JPEG preview encoding alone. Root cause remains under investigation; main-screen video cannot generally be called passing.
No SELinux changes, root hiding, APK modifications, or downgrades to old packages.
Installed on the current development emulator; exported system.img has not been re-exported. These three third-party APKs reside in data, which is not system-image preinstallation/distribution.
Official channels may roll out in batches. Versions refer to current downloads from official sites in this run and are not guaranteed to cover every app store/test channel.
